scope: diagnostic research A and B; synthetic only; no biological training
effect_selection: fixed ranges in worlds.py; not tuned to evaluation outcomes
stopping: main policy runs complete budget; stop counterfactual evaluated at pre-frozen prefixes only

hypotheses.F1: finite-look correction reduces all-null false warning versus naive repeated p<0.05
hypotheses.F2: reference measurements plus observation-aware inference resolve within-model gain/offset confounding better than no-reference acquisition
hypotheses.F3: block-targeted acquisition is compared, not presumed superior, to two-point-calibration then balanced sampling at equal cap
hypotheses.F4: propagating calibration and estimated noise changes interval calibration on same acquired records
hypotheses.F5: fixed audit panels can miss localized or non-transportable faults; warning is not source certification

analysis: world-level descriptive bootstrap intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted superiority tests; paired policy comparisons
